title: Tariffs, geopolitics, and the new logic of global dealmaking
discussion_signal: The discussion frames tariffs, export controls, and geopolitical conflict as durable variables that push firms from lowest-cost sourcing toward resilience and acquisition. It connects state strategy to firm behavior while leaving open who pays for redundancy and whether resilience improves public security.
linked_research_question: How do domestic exposure, supply dependence, alliances, and state strategy alter strategic room and the distribution of risk?
